$note: New carrier - Flightlink (Tanzania-based regional carrier). Flagging up front per CLAUDE.md's Tanzania-scope caution: this carrier's network is almost entirely Tanzania-domestic/regional (Zanzibar, Dar es Salaam, Arusha, Serengeti, Kilimanjaro, Mwanza, Pemba), with only a handful of legs touching Nairobi Wilson/JKIA. CLAUDE.md says Tanzania product lines are out of scope by default (see '4x4 Safaris TZ Contract Rates' - Excluded for now) and should only be brought in deliberately for a combined Kenya-Tanzania itinerary. This file is extracted because it was explicitly named in this extraction task's target list, but treat it as supporting-only for cross-border itineraries, not part of the core Kenya rate base.

validity.note: Schedule/fares doc header itself says WEF 1 Jun 2025 to 31 Dec 2026, but the notes section on the final page states validity as 1 June 2025 to 31 May 2027 - the document contradicts itself on its own end date. Recorded both, flagging the discrepancy rather than picking one.

fareBasis: Tax-inclusive (domestic & regional), one-way, 'FROM' fares (i.e. lowest fare on that route/time, not necessarily every departure time listed at that price) - per Flightlink's own Fare Tiers & Policies (not reproduced in this document).
timezone: All times local, EAT (+3 GMT). '+' prefix on an arrival time denotes next-day arrival.

kenyaRelevantLegs.note: The only legs directly touching Kenya (Nairobi Wilson or Nairobi JKIA) - most relevant to a Kenya-based itinerary that also touches Tanzania.

tanzaniaDomesticNetworkSummary.note: Extensive Tanzania-internal network NOT itemized in full here (Dar es Salaam/Zanzibar/Arusha/Pemba/Mwanza/Kilimanjaro/Serengeti-all-airstrips/Lake Manyara/Ngorongoro, multiple daily frequencies each) since it's out of scope per CLAUDE.md's Tanzania exclusion unless a combined itinerary is being built. Full route/fare/schedule table is in the source PDF if needed for a future Kenya-Tanzania combined quote - re-extract fully at that time rather than relying on this summary.
